WITH operator_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    crewref,
    COUNT(*) as num_scans,
    AVG(gbsize / spanmin) as avg_gb_per_min
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY crewref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(gbsize / spanmin) as overall_avg
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  AVG(num_scans) as avg_num_scans,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_min) - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg) as avg_margin_above
FROM operator_stats
WHERE avg_gb_per_min > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg)
